spans.s: लज् (I) vi. 1Ā (pres. लजते) To be ashamed.
लज् (II) vt. 1P (pres. लंजति) 1. To blame, to calumniate; 2. to roast to fry.
लज् (III) vi. 10U (pres. लजयति-ते) To seem, to appear, to shine.
लज् (IV) vt. 10U (pres. लाजयति-ते) To cover, to conceal.
लज् (V) vt. or vi. 10U (pres. लंजयति-ते) 1. To speak; 2. to injure, to kill; 3. to give; 4. to be powerful, to be strong; 5. to dwell.
लाज् vt. 1P (pres. लाजति, लांजति) 1. To blame, to censure; 2. to fry, to roast.
लज्जका f. The wild cotton-plant.
लज्जा f. 1. Shame, feeling of shame, लज्जा तिरश्चां यदि चेतसि स्यात् K.S.i.48, R.ii.40; 2. bashfulness, modesty, लज्जावती लाजविसर्गमग्नौ R.vii.25, K.S.iii.7; 3. name of a sensitive plant.
लाज (I) m. Wetted grain.
लाज (II) m. pl. Parched grain, आचारलाजैरिव पौरकन्याः R.ii.10, iv.27, K.S.vii.69, R.vii.25.
लाजा f. pl. Parched grain.
लज्जा-अन्वित a. modest, lashful.
लज्जा-कर a. (f. रा or री) occasioning shame.

लज्जालु (I) a. Modest, bashful.
